title: dbdash.nvim dashboard
description: One dashboard: either a single chart (database / query / show) or several panels (panels / layout). See :help dbdash-config.

interval.description: Default refresh interval. With panels it is also a global timer: when it elapses every panel refreshes and the panels' own timers restart.

args.description: Arguments shared by all panels, merged by name with each panel's query.args (the same name must be declared identically).

args_show.description: Show the argument values above the charts.

panels.description: Charts placed left to right, wrapping into rows (see show.span).

duration.description: Seconds as a number, or a string with a unit: "500ms", "30s", "5m", "1h".

type.description: Database type; inferred from the URL scheme when omitted.

url.description:
Connection URL: <scheme>://[user[:password]@]host[:port][/database][?param=value&...]
User names and passwords are percent-decoded (write @ as %40, : as %3A).

SQLite      sqlite:///absolute/path.db                (or sqlite3://)
            sqlite://relative/to/this/config.db
            sqlite:///:memory:
PostgreSQL  postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db        (or postgresql://)
            auth: cleartext, md5, SCRAM-SHA-256; ?options=-c%20search_path%3Dapp
MySQL       mysql://user:pass@host:3306/db           (or mariadb://)
            auth: mysql_native_password, caching_sha2_password
Redis       redis://[user]:pass@host:6379/0          (rediss:// = TLS)
MongoDB     mongodb://user:pass@host:27017/db?authSource=admin
            mongodb://user:pass@h1:27017,h2:27017/db?readPreference=secondaryPreferred
            mongodb+srv://user:pass@cluster0.example.net/db   (SRV + TXT lookup,
            defaults to tls=verify-full; ?dns=host:port picks the name server)
            ?authMechanism=SCRAM-SHA-256|SCRAM-SHA-1
Cassandra   cassandra://user:pass@host:9042/keyspace?consistency=LOCAL_QUORUM
            (or cql://)
SQL Server  mssql://user:pass@host:1433/db            (or sqlserver://)
            with TLS: TLS negotiated inside TDS; &encrypt=strict for TDS 8

Common parameters:
  tls=disable|require|pin|verify-ca|verify-full   (default disable)
  fingerprint=sha256:AB:CD:...                    (required for tls=pin)
  ca=path/to/ca.pem                              (verify-*: trusted CAs instead of
                                                  the system store; relative to
                                                  this config file)
  tls_host=name                                  (name to verify instead of host)
  connect_timeout=10s   timeout=30s              (defaults: setup)
  application_name=dbdash.nvim

lib_path.description: SQLite: path of the libsqlite3 library to load.

create.description: SQLite: create the file when it does not exist (default false).

name.description: Variable name in the query template.

type.description: How command-line / prompt input is parsed: list "a,b,c", map "k:v,k2:v2", boolean true/false/1/0/yes/no. Escape , and : with a backslash or quotes.

default.description: Value when nothing else sets it (an argument without a value is none).

required.description: Ask for a value at start when it has none.

show.description: Include the argument in the args_show line.

sql.description:
Query template (Jinja subset, see :help dbdash-templates). Its language depends on
the database:
  SQL databases  SQL (T-SQL for SQL Server, CQL for Cassandra)
  Redis          one command, e.g. HGETALL "user:1001"
  MongoDB        a JSON document:
                 {"collection": "orders", "operation": "find",
                  "filter": {...}, "projection": {...}, "sort": {...},
                  "limit": 100, "flatten": 1}
                 operation: find | aggregate (pipeline) | count |
                 distinct (field) | command (command)

args_show.description: Show the argument values above the chart.

autoescape.description: Render {{ x }} as SQL literals of the database's dialect (| safe opts out).

max_rows.description: Rows read at most (default 10000, setup defaults.max_rows).

timeout.description: Query timeout (default the URL's timeout, else 30s from setup defaults.timeout).

database.description: Overrides the top-level database for this panel.

color.description: Hex ("#3498db"), a color name ("blue", "bright_blue"), a style ("bold blue on black"), or an existing highlight group ("DiagnosticOk").

interval.description: Refresh interval of this chart (default the top-level interval, else 30s from setup defaults.interval). At least 1s.

countdown_format.description: {time} is replaced by the seconds left (default: setup defaults.countdown_format).

renderer.description:
Style for the chart type (the first one is the default):
  table: box          line: canvas, asciichart     scatter/area/bubble: canvas
  bar: horizontal, vertical    histogram: horizontal, vertical
  boxplot: boxdraw    heatmap: halfblock, block    pie: bar, circle
Custom styles registered with setup({ register = ... }) are accepted too.

canvas.description: Pixel canvas for canvas styles: braille (default), quadrant, block, halfblock, ascii.

palette.description: Series colors: theme (default, follows the colorscheme) or tableau.

style.description:
Chart options:
  table      border, header_style, border_style, title_style, show_lines, null_text
  area       stacked
  bar        color, show_values
  histogram  color, show_values
  boxplot    show_outliers, show_means
  heatmap    show_values (block renderer)
  pie        show_labels, show_values, show_percentages

colors.description: Series / slice colors, by position (list) or by category name (mapping).

column_list.description: Table columns to show, in order (all columns when omitted).
